gitCommit.subject: S7b fix 1: compare row markup without renderer handler ids
gitCommit.body:
S7b fix 1: compare row markup without renderer handler ids

TheRows_AreIdenticalInTheBottomSheetAndInThePanel (Drivers, Vehicles,
Places) compared the OuterHtml of the two lists with Assert.Equal. It now
compares them with bUnit's MarkupMatches, after checking that both lists
have the same, non-zero number of rows. Elements, classes, text and every
other attribute are still held to equal; only blazor:* attributes are
left out of the comparison.

ROOT CAUSE: bUnit writes each event handler into the markup as
blazor:onclick="<id>", and the renderer assigns a fresh id to every
handler on every render. The sheet and the panel are two renders of the
same rows, so the strings differed in those ids alone (blazor:onclick="7"
against "17", "18", "27"), which a raw string comparison cannot ignore.
MarkupMatches goes through bUnit's HtmlComparer, whose
BlazorAttributeFilter excludes every attribute that starts with "blazor:"
(Htmlizer.IsBlazorAttribute, bUnit 2.11.3). No other test in the repo
compares raw Markup/OuterHtml across two renders; the remaining InnerHtml
comparisons are of SVG glyphs, which carry no handlers.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
